text:
Riley M.: opened PR to trim duplication and fix anchors for the structured-output guide: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4991. need quick sanity on snippets and nullable payload wording.
Chen W.: CL on my radar. which snippets change the most?
Riley M.: mostly examples that used the old tool envelope. switching to action-response shape and normalizing payload null vs {}.
Noel H.: small preference: use payload: null to represent absent data in canonical examples. add one note explaining the difference.
Riley M.: agreed. sample I'll keep in the guide:
```json
{ "action": "get_item", "args": { "id": "i_9" }, "response": { "status": "ok", "payload": null } }
```
Chen W.: also saw a few JS SDK snippets calling client.invoke; prefer client.callAction. i'll open a tiny follow-up PR for replacements where callAction exists.
Riley M.: thanks. CI bot flagged a bunch of stale anchors. Noel, can you run a link-check and add redirects for the ones people still link to externally?
ci-bot: link-checker: 7 broken links in docs/guides/structured-output (job #2047).
Noel H.: will triage. plan: add permanent anchors on the old long_examples page and update internal links to /spec/structured-output.
Riley M.: last blocker before merge: markdown-lint must be green. Chen, can you run the linter?
Chen W.: running now. will push fix for frontmatter spacing if it fails.
ci-bot: markdown-lint: OK. link-checker: 0 failures after fixes. docs preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-4991
Riley M.: merged, thanks y'all :tada:
